messages:
Omar R: Quick heads-up — after yesterday's kernel-selection tweak (auto-fused-attn -> fused_v2) perf-5 runs show +12% GPU memory fragmentation and 3 OOMs during the short-chat batchy workload. attaching profiler dump.
Sasha L: Ugh. Which part of fused_v2 changed alloc pattern? Any evidence of non-inplace copies/kernels?
Omar R: perf trace shows a new intermediate buffer in attention forward when seq_len < 128; allocator churn from many small KV allocations spikes at request tail.
Mike T: hypothesis: fused_v2 allocs smaller, more numerous -> slab fragmentation. Also prefill path still uses larger contiguous buffers so when both paths interleave we get holes.
Jen C: Repro-bot: reproduced on ray-qa1 with the same load. Summary:
repro-bot: "workload=short-chat, concurrency=40, batcher=dynamic, seq=64-96 -> avg frag +12%, OOMs at ~87% GPU live" 
Omar R: Perf snippet:
```text
alloc tail: 0x7ff... size 4096 x 142
slab_free_chunks: 312 -> 198
kv_alloc_requests_per_min: 1234
```
Mike T: Quick mitigation ideas:
- enable slab_coalesce=true (coalesce small free chunks) 
- lower kv-prefill per-request cap from 32MB -> 16MB to reduce prefill pressure
- add background slab_compact every 30s for idle GPUs
Jen C: Tradeoffs: lowering prefill cap reduces tail-latency for long-contexts. slab_compact may pause short if synchronous.
Sasha L: Can we test combinations? e.g. slab_coalesce on + prefill cap 24MB, and separate test with prefill 16MB + no coalesce. Need perf numbers.
Mike T: I'll add a small perf harness: `tools/bench/gpu_mem_sweep --mode=kv_mix --iters=10 --concurrency=40`. Also adding metric kv_prefill_allocs_per_req and slab_free_fragmentation_ratio.
Omar R: Also want to try kernel rollback: revert fused_v2 alloc pattern to use preallocated temp buffer via workspace allocator (should reduce small allocs). But that touches kernel codegen.
deploy-bot: Rollout of fused_v2 paused in prod (canary 3/5) due to OOM alerts. :warning:
Jen C: I'll run 4 combos on qa cluster this afternoon and post CSV with mem/latency/oom counts. Mike please add the metrics to the trace so we can correlate.
Mike T: will do. also adding a quick patch to make slab_compact async while testing.
Omar R: Thanks — if we can get a 50% reduction in fragmentation with coalesce+compact we can keep fused_v2. If not, rollback kernel and iterate.
Sasha L: pinging @infra on scheduling extra QA GPUs if needed.
